title: workflow.task.created payload
description: Emitted by BMS when a human-in-the-loop task is created. Consumed by Notifications.

assignee.description: A user id, or the id of the group or role the task is offered to — `assigneeKind` says which.

assigneeKind.description: What `assignee` names. A workflow's human step names a user or a role (EP-25.1). Absent means a user — what BMS sent before it said.

reviewPointId.description: Set on a review step's task (EP-22.6): the point in the workflow this approval is for. The verdict is given in MAM, naming this point (`POST /assets/{id}/approve` or `/reject` with `reviewPointId`), and it — not completing the task — moves the workflow; Notifications refuses to complete such a task by hand, and closes it on BMS's `workflow.task.resolved`.
